items remain unchanged. This is an in-progress disposition pass, not a claim
that all preliminary reports have been consolidated or independently approved.

| Decision | Resource / ID / variant | Current Korean | Proposed Korean | Disposition | Evidence and rationale |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| D-001 | `base` 1741 / 11 | `야수` | `야수(The Beast)` | accepted | English title is `The Beast`; Japanese explicitly retains “The”; user confirms this is a weapon item. The common-noun-only Korean flattens its unique title identity. English parenthetical preserves traceability without changing the meaning. |
| D-002 | `base` 1746 / 11 | `문지기 레버` | `문 레버` | accepted | English and Japanese both say `Gate Lever`, and Chinese says `门杠杆`. `문지기` means a gatekeeper, changing the object. The concise `문 레버` preserves the source category without adding an unverified mechanism. |
| D-003 | `base` 4674 / 11 | `반지` | unchanged | superseded by D-18202 | At the earlier review, Chinese `戒指` was treated as evidence for a ring and English `Band` remained ambiguous. The user later confirmed the item is not a ring; see D-18202. |
| D-004 | `affix` 128 / 11, 12, 14, 21, 22, 24 | `얼음 방패의` | `*얼음 방패*` | accepted (resolved by D-18201) | English `of Ice Shield` and Japanese `オブ アイスシールド` support a postposed relation; the literal asterisk delimiters distinguish the Korean suffix segment without a stranded genitive. All six variants were updated under D-18201. |
| D-005 | `default` 5402 | `...시단(Cydan)만 바라봤어...` | `...시단(Cydan)에게 푹 빠졌어...` | accepted | English idiom `mooned over`, Japanese `夢中になった`, and Chinese `痴迷` all mean romantic infatuation. Literal `바라봤어` weakens the idiom to looking. The proposed phrasing preserves the line's casual register. |
| D-006 | `default` 13727 | `불쌍한 어린 말리온(Mallion)이 ... 대부분의 시간을 보내.` | `불쌍한 어린 말리온(Mallion)의 병상 곁에서 대부분의 시간을 보내.` | accepted | English explicitly has `She`, Chinese has `她`, and Japanese's subject is omitted but agrees with the surrounding referent. Korean incorrectly makes Mallion the subject of “spends time.” The correction restores the source agency without adding a pronoun. |
| D-007 | `default` 34710 | `에사 알파린, 잘 부탁하네!` | `에사 알파린, 무엇이든 맡겨 주게!` | accepted | English `at your service`, Japanese `何でも言ってくれ`, and Chinese `为你效劳` offer help/service to the listener. `잘 부탁하네` reverses the pragmatic direction into a request for consideration. The proposed line keeps a concise, familiar service offer. |
| D-008 | `default` 5340 | `대기실을 통해서만 지나갈 수 있어.` | `전실을 통해서만 지나갈 수 있어.` | accepted | English `antechamber`, Japanese `控えの間`, and Chinese `前厅` all refer to an anteroom/access chamber, not a modern waiting room. `전실` preserves that spatial function concisely. |

below are based on the decision-register rows, including this batch.

## Review Rule Correction and Source-Only Checkpoint D-19564

This entry supersedes the PAK-dependent D-19560 rationale and the
PAK-extraction search recorded under D-19563. Do not inspect, extract,
search, compare, or cite PAKs or PAK-derived files as translation evidence.
English is the semantic anchor; Japanese informs voice/register; Chinese is
supporting evidence. Close source-faithful Korean as `not an issue`, accept
evidence-backed corrections, and reserve `uncertain` for material ambiguity
that changes the Korean and remains unresolved after one focused review.
Do not repeat negative searches or carry a hold forward merely because new
evidence did not appear.

## D-21267: Reddle Mane

Reviewed 20 exact `base`/`default` source keys and registered
`person:reddle-mane` as `레들 메인(Reddle Mane)`. All 20 Korean cells already
used the canonical bilingual form, so each is `not-an-issue` and no CSV cell
changed. English identifies the Adessan human/Alfar leader; Japanese
レドル・メイン and Chinese 瑞德尔·迈恩 corroborate the personal name. Direct
source search included possessive default:56409, omitted by the heuristic
candidate list. Fifty already-indexed matches for other entities overlap the
same rows and remain unchanged. The follower and petition-board metonymies do
not establish a separate faction. Historical findings were not reopened or
recounted. See the D-21267 report, addendum, and exact trilingual manifest.

## D-21266: Madding Wind

Reviewed 46 distinct `base`/`default` source row keys and registered
`place:madding-wind` as `매딩 윈드(Madding Wind)`. Accepted 24 default-cell

correct. Use `매딩 윈드 감옥(Madding Wind Prison)` only for the standalone

default:37966, were not reopened. See the D-21266 review, addendum, and exact
trilingual manifest.
